GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-04-15T06:06:26Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Using output type in the response of mutations
Description: ## Summary
I want to send a field of `ObjectGraph` type in the response of a mutation. I am using apollo GraphQL on the client-side. Returning this way helps with the caching.
I tried to add a field for `ItemGraph` inside `ItemInputGraph`.  But, it will throw an exception since `ItemInputGraph` is of `IInputObjectGraphType` type. Is it possible to add this only at the response of a mutation?

`mutation MarkAsCompleted($item:ItemInputGraph!){
    markAsCompleted(item: $item){
        success
        item { # this should be the same output type used for querying item
            id
            name
            type
            isCompleted
            completedOn
            completedBy
        }
    }
}`
